integrity: Complete self-contained proof and standalone exact checker included; code output is explicitly separate from the all-length reasoning.
scientific_limitations: One-step spectrum proved for all indexed cyclic word lengths \(n\ge3\); all-positive-time equivalence only for odd n or n not divisible by three.
For even multiples of three only the first additional collision at time two is claimed, not the full later-time spectrum.
The full text of a relevant 2007 unrestricted inverse-rule article was not obtained; possible unindexed earlier equivalent coverage remains.
Finite checker supports but does not establish the infinite theorem; independent validation not performed.
title: Exact inversion fibers of cyclic Rule 150 on the Lucas language
